title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - PointOfPresence
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/PointOfPresence. Point of connection between separate communicating entities. Subclass of PhysicalResource per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the PhysicalResource model and not repeated here. Note: 'maintainedBy' is re-declared here with a narrower range (InternetServiceProvider) than PhysicalResource's own 'maintainedBy' (LegalPerson), per the source ontology's slot_usage override mechanism.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PointOfPresence'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

interconnectedParticipants.description: Relationship. Legal persons interconnecting their networks via this point of presence. Links to one or more LegalPerson entities.

interconnectionPointIdentifier.description: Relationship. Definition of the location where resources can interconnect. Links to an InterconnectionPointIdentifier entity.

maintainedBy.description: Relationship. ISP in charge of managing the IP transit (or internet transit) of this point of presence. Links to one or more InternetServiceProvider entities.
